# MoAI ADK

> MoAI ADK is an open-source development kit that runs one workflow (read, plan, run, verify, audit, sync) inside Claude Code and Codex through a single shared `moai` skill, with GitHub Issues as the work ledger. The Rust release candidate `moai-cli 2026.11.0-rc.1` is not yet released; the stable release is the Go 3.x generation.

Draft for the documentation site root (`/llms.txt`, format from https://llmstxt.org/). It is not published; publishing waits for a maintainer decision. Links point to the release-candidate branch on GitHub.

Key facts:

- License: Apache-2.0.
- RC1 language and binary: Rust, `moai` (alias `moai-cli`). Previous generation: Go `moai` 3.x on the `main` branch.
- RC1 target scope: Claude Code and Codex on macOS arm64. Host end-to-end tests have not run yet, so this is a target, not a support guarantee.
- Merge gate: an independent audit by a session other than the author, recorded as the `moai/audit` commit status on the exact head commit.
